title: Move-in
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM
If a contract has not yet been invoiced, proceed as follows:

e Reverse the move-in document: Execute move-in with the correct business partner. You can use the move-in document as a
template.

e Create an intermediate bill.

e Wait for the next bill and then execute the customer change.

Move-in

Use

You use the move-in function to carry out most of the activities required to begin providing a business partner with a utility service.
You create new, or change existing business master data. Most importantly, you allocate a contract to an installation.

In move-in processing, you establish whether a contract can be billed. From the move-in, you can also trigger the charges levied at
the commencement of a utility service, as well as a welcome letter to the customer.

Prerequisites

To create a move-in, you require one or more installations that are vacant on the desired move-in date.

e Inthe case of an initial move-in, ensure that you have completed initial data creation, including creation of the
installation(s).

e Devices can (but do not have to) be installed and allocated before move-in.

e If one of the installations is already allocated to a contract, this allocation must be reversed. To do this, process a move-out.
An installation can only be allocated to one contract at any given time.

Features

Customer Contact

When a move-in is created, a corresponding customer contact is created automatically. This is automatically linked to the move-in
document. You can find additional information in the section on Customer contact.

Overall Check

When a contract is assigned the move-in status 05 (meter reading entered completely), you can verify that the contract can be
billed.

Move-In Status

If you process or display a move-in document, the system also displays the move-in status of each contract. The move-in status
informs the agent which stage of move-in processing has been reached.

The minimum is formed from the move-in status of the contracts and also displayed. In this way you can obtain information on the

ctatus of the entire move-in nrocessing.
